# NESTA Certified

> > NESTA (National Exercise & Sports Trainers Association) provides NCCA-accredited Personal Fitness Trainer certification and continuing education for fitness professionals.

NESTA offers comprehensive online fitness education through their Personal Fitness Trainer (PFT) certification program, which is accredited by the National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA). The organization also operates the Spencer Institute and provides career resources for fitness professionals seeking employment at major gym chains like 24 Hour Fitness, Equinox, LA Fitness, and Anytime Fitness.

## Key Topics

- NESTA Personal Fitness Trainer (PFT) Certification
- NCCA Accreditation
- National Commission for Certifying Agencies
- CPT (Certified Personal Trainer)
- Spencer Institute
- Continuing Education Units (CEU)
- Online Fitness Certification
- Personal Trainer Career Development
- Fitness Professional Recertification
- NESTA Learning Management System
- Accredited Certification Programs
- Fitness Education & Training
- Professional Fitness Credentials

## Personal Fitness Trainer (PFT) Certification

- [Become an Accredited Personal Trainer](https://pft.nestacertified.com): NCCA-accredited NESTA Personal Fitness Trainer certification program
- [Start Your NESTA Personal Fitness Trainer Certification Today](https://pft.nestacertified.com/start): Entry point to begin NESTA PFT certification with exam scheduling
- [The Mission of NESTA's Personal Fitness Trainer (PFT) Program](https://pft.nestacertified.com/about-nesta-mission-statement): NESTA's mission statement and PFT program overview with NCCA accreditation
- [NESTA PFT Recertification & Continuing Education (CEU) Guide](https://pft.nestacertified.com/nesta-personal-fitness-trainer-continuing-education-ceu-recertification): NESTA PFT 4.0 CEU requirements and recertification process guide

## Certification Guides & Career Resources

- [5 Steps to Achieve Your Accredited Personal Trainer Certification](https://nestacertified.com/5-steps-to-achieve-your-accredited-personal-trainer-certification): Guide to earning NCCA-accredited personal trainer certification
- [Achieve Fast Personal Trainer Certification in 5 Simple Steps](https://nestacertified.com/achieve-fast-personal-trainer-certification-in-5-simple-steps): Fast-track guide to obtaining personal trainer certification quickly
- [Your Step-by-Step Guide to Personal Trainer Certification USA](https://nestacertified.com/your-step-by-step-guide-to-personal-trainer-certification-usa): Comprehensive guide to obtaining personal trainer certification in USA
- [Discover the Best Online Personal Trainer Certification Options](https://nestacertified.com/discover-the-best-online-personal-trainer-certification-options): Comparison guide for online personal trainer certification programs
